name: Ondrel
summary: Crisp white planning-tool site framed by thin vertical guide rails, with a tight Inter Display headline, a full roadmap app mock floating on a pastel sky photo and realistic UI cards in place of feature icons.

fonts.pairing: Inter Display 600 at 72px with -0.035em tracking for H1, 500 for H2 to H4 with the tail of each heading in grey; Inter 500 at 15 to 18px for body, 12 to 13px labels inside UI mocks

signature: page framed by two hairline vertical rails with full-width horizontal rules between sections, like a ruled sheet
full roadmap app window (sidebar, timeline, today line, progress bars) floating on a soft pink and blue sky photograph
sticky feature index on the left that switches state as each feature block scrolls past
headings that run into a grey continuation sentence on the same line
AI-drafted update card with coloured status pills and emoji reaction counts on an iridescent blur panel
imagery: pastel cloud and sky photography and iridescent soft gradients used only as backdrops behind high-fidelity product UI; a few muted architectural photos for customer stories
layout_grid: 1200 frame, 32px sides inside 1px vertical rails, about 96px section padding, 1px horizontal rules between sections, 6 to 8px radius on UI elements, 20px radius on image panels, pill buttons 999px for badges, light layered shadows only on floating cards
